name: cheer_joi_v3_test_pose
summary: v3 test 2 of 2, POSED: kneeling on the bed - a free leg talking, a leg landing back on the same key, then a small change of pose to kneel_hair. Checks that a held pose moves like a person and not a still, and her face over a free leg.
suffix: one continuous shot, smooth natural motion, she moves slowly and gently, small smooth movements
negative: fast motion, motion blur, camera cut, scene change, morphing, face change, different person

segments.motion: kneeling on the bed, she talks to the viewer with a commanding smile, slowly tilting her head
kneeling on the bed, she slowly runs her hands up her waist, over her chest and back down to her thighs, never looking away from the viewer
kneeling on the bed, she slowly draws her ponytail forward over her shoulder with one hand, smiling at the viewer
